text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d t-h-e c-o-n-s-p-i-r-a-c-y p-l-a-n s-o t-w-o r-i-v-a-l s-f-i-r-m-s c-o-u-l-d i-s-s-u-e s-h-a-d-d o-c-s u-n-d-e-r c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a p-a-p-e-r t-r-a-i-l o-f c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n o-f i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t p-r-i-c-i-n-g.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-r-r-a-n-g-e-d h-i-d-d-e-n r-e-c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n t-o o-f-f-e-t l-o-s-i-n-g b-i-d-d-e-r-s, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g s-t-e-a-l-t-h f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s, a-n-d l-e-a-v-i-n-g o-f-f-b-o-o-k t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s t-h-a-t w-e-r-e n-e-v-e r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d f-o-r a-u-d-i-t.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-h-a-r-e-d c-o-s-t a-n-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g d-a-t-a a-c-r-o-s-s c-o-m-p-e-t-i-n-g f-i-r-m-s t-o a-l-i-g-n b-i-d a-m-o-u-n-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g m-e-t-i-n-g n-o-t-e-s a-n-d e-m-a-i-l c-h-a-i-n-s w-i-t-h m-a-t-c-h-e-d n-u-m-b-e-r-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n b-a-r-r-i-e-r p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d a b-i-d r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e s-o w-i-n-n-i-n-g r-i-g-h-t-s w-o-u-l-d r-o-t-a-t-e a-m-o-n-g t-h-e c-a-r-t-e-l m-e-m-b-e-r-s, p-r-o-d-u-c-i-n-g a c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t s-h-o-w-i-n-g p-l-a-n-n-e-d w-i-n-n-e-r-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t q-u-a-l-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-m-a-t-t-e-d b-i-d-d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s t-o a-p-p-e-a-r c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e w-i-t-h s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d d-i-s-c-r-e-p-a-n-c-y i-n b-i-d v-a-l-u-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a p-o-l-i-s-h-e-d p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t f-i-l-e t-h-a-t m-i-m-i-c-k-e-d m-a-r-k-e-t b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f b-i-d-d-e-r a-u-t-h-o-n-o-m-y.
